getWindow.name: Get window
getWindow.desc: Find a program's window, in front or by title, and remember its handle, title, program, position, size and screen in a variable.

setWindow.name: Set window
setWindow.desc: Bring a program's window to the front, minimize, maximize, move or resize it, put it on a screen, or close it.

mouse.name: Mouse sequence
mouse.desc: Move, click, scroll and drag the mouse, step by step.

getScreen.name: Get screen
getScreen.desc: Remember a screen's size, position, scale and DPI in a variable.

debug.name: Debug window
debug.desc: Show a window with a text, placeholders filled in; running the action again updates it.

switchPage.name: Switch page
switchPage.desc: Show another page on the Launchpad.

setColor.name: Set colour
setColor.desc: Change and remember the colour of this or any other button.

runButton.name: Run another button
runButton.desc: Run the actions of another button as part of this one.

setFader.name: Set fader
setFader.desc: Move a fader to a value, as if its pad had been pressed.

stopAllMacros.name: Stop all macros
stopAllMacros.desc: Stops every running macro, including this one.

stopThisMacro.name: Stop this macro
stopThisMacro.desc: Stops every macro running on this button, including this one.

restartThisMacro.name: Restart this macro
restartThisMacro.desc: Stops older runs of this button so only the newest continues.

pushToTalkStart.name: Push-to-talk on
pushToTalkStart.desc: Holds the push-to-talk key until the matching “off” marker.

pushToTalkEnd.name: Push-to-talk off
pushToTalkEnd.desc: Releases the push-to-talk key held by the “on” marker.

flipFlopStart.name: Flip flop: A
flipFlopStart.desc: Actions up to the B marker run on every other press.

flipFlopMiddle.name: Flip flop: B
flipFlopMiddle.desc: Actions up to the end marker run on the presses in between.

flipFlopEnd.name: Flip flop: end
flipFlopEnd.desc: Everything after this runs on every press.

setSystemVolume.name: System audio
setSystemVolume.desc: Set, nudge or mute the volume of the speakers or the microphone, fixed or from a fader.

stopAllSounds.name: Stop all sounds
stopAllSounds.desc: Silences every sound Lunchpad is playing.

setAudioDevice.name: Switch audio device
setAudioDevice.desc: Make a device the system default, so all sound plays (or records) through it.

addToVariable.name: Add to variable
addToVariable.desc: Count up or down: add a number to a variable.

obsStudioMode.name: OBS: studio mode
obsStudioMode.desc: Turn studio mode on or off, or transition the preview scene to the program.

obsTriggerHotkey.name: OBS: trigger hotkey
obsTriggerHotkey.desc: Fire one of OBS Studio's hotkeys over the websocket, without giving OBS the focus.

slobsSwitchScene.name: Streamlabs: switch scene
slobsSwitchScene.desc: Make a scene live, optionally in another scene collection.

slobsToggleSource.name: Streamlabs: show or hide source
slobsToggleSource.desc: Show or hide a source in a scene.

slobsSetAudio.name: Streamlabs: set audio
slobsSetAudio.desc: Mute or unmute a mixer source and set its fader.

slobsToggleFilter.name: Streamlabs: toggle filter
slobsToggleFilter.desc: Turn a filter of a source on or off.

slobsStream.name: Streamlabs: stream, record, replay
slobsStream.desc: Start, stop or toggle the stream, the recording or the replay buffer.

slobsSaveReplay.name: Streamlabs: save replay
slobsSaveReplay.desc: Save the replay buffer to a file.

slobsStudioMode.name: Streamlabs: studio mode
slobsStudioMode.desc: Turn studio mode on or off, or push the preview scene live.

homeAssistantTurn.name: Home Assistant: on / off
homeAssistantTurn.desc: Turn any entity on or off, or toggle it.

homeAssistantSetValue.name: Home Assistant: set a value
homeAssistantSetValue.desc: Brightness, colour temperature, cover position, fan speed, volume, a number or a temperature, fixed or from a fader.

homeAssistantCallService.name: Home Assistant: call a service
homeAssistantCallService.desc: Any service of any domain, with JSON data and placeholders.

httpRequest.name: HTTP request
httpRequest.desc: Call a web address with any method, headers, body and login.

setVariable.name: Set variable
setVariable.desc: Remember a value for later actions.

runScript.name: Run script
runScript.desc: Run a small JavaScript snippet that can read and change variables.

ifStart.name: Condition
ifStart.desc: Actions up to “Otherwise” run when the check holds.

ifElse.name: Otherwise
ifElse.desc: Actions up to “End condition” run when the check does not hold.

ifEnd.name: End condition
ifEnd.desc: Everything after this runs either way.

playSound.doc: Play an audio file on an output device (`None` = app default device).

fields.name: volume
fields.doc: 1.0 = 100 %; legacy allowed up to 20.0

fields.name: start
fields.doc: Trim start, 0.0..1.0 of the file

fields.name: end
fields.doc: Trim end, 0.0..1.0 of the file

fields.name: volumeFromVelocity
fields.doc: Scale the volume by the trigger velocity (velocity-sensitive pads)

fields.name: saveOutputTo
fields.doc: Store the program's standard output in this variable (needs `wait`)

getWindow.doc: Find another program's window, the one in front or by title, and remember it: `<name>` = its handle, plus `.title`, `.app`, `.x`, `.y`, `.width` and `.height`.

setWindow.doc: Find another program's window and raise, minimize, maximize, restore, lower, close, move, size or center it.

fields.name: screen
fields.doc: 1-based screen number, blank for the window's own; `move`, `bounds` and `center` take it as their frame of reference, `screen` moves there.

mouse.doc: Mouse steps run in order: move, click, press, release, scroll, drag, wait.

getScreen.doc: Remember a screen: `<name>` = JSON with number, x, y, width, height, scale, dpi, primary and count (of screens), each also as `<name>.<field>`.

fields.name: number
fields.doc: The 1-based number, for `pick: number` (placeholders)

debug.doc: Show a window with `text`, placeholders filled in. Each action has its own window; running it again updates the text.

fields.name: alwaysOnTop
fields.doc: Keep the window above the others

mousePosition.doc: Remember where the pointer is: `<name>` = "x,y", plus `.x` and `.y`.

fields.name: msFrom
fields.doc: A variable (or `{{template}}`) holding the milliseconds; `ms` when it is missing or not a number.

setColor.doc: Change and persist the colour of a button: this one (no target) or any other button on any page.

setFader.doc: Move a fader (by name) to a value, as if its pad had been pressed: LEDs, `fader.<name>` and, unless `run_actions` is off, its actions.

fields.name: value
fields.doc: Number or placeholder, clamped to the fader's range

runButton.doc: Run another button's actions as part of this chain. With `wait` the runner waits for the other button's macro to finish.

flipFlopStart.doc: Actions between Start and Middle run on "A" presses, between Middle and End on "B" presses; `is_a` alternates and is persisted.

fields.name: mode
fields.doc: Show / hide / toggle; `None` falls back to `visible`

fields.name: muteMode
fields.doc: Mute / unmute / toggle / keep; `None` falls back to `muted`

fields.name: volumeDb
fields.doc: Volume in `volume_unit` (dB: -100..26, percent: 0..2000 like OBS's advanced audio properties)

fields.name: volumeFrom
fields.doc: Variable or placeholder that overrides `volume_db` when it holds a number (faders write `value`)

fields.name: setVolume
fields.doc: Whether the volume is applied at all (a pure mute button leaves it alone)

obsStudioMode.doc: Studio mode on/off, or push the preview scene to the program.

obsTriggerHotkey.doc: Fire an OBS hotkey over the websocket, without giving OBS the focus: by its name (`OBSBasic.StartStreaming`; `context` names the source for per-source ones such as `libobs.mute`) or by the key combination bound in OBS (`key` is an OBS key id such as `OBS_KEY_F5`).

slobsSwitchScene.doc: Streamlabs Desktop: the same controls as OBS, by name.

fields.name: volumeDb
fields.doc: Volume in `volume_unit`: dB mapped onto the mixer fader, or percent as the fader position

stopAllSounds.doc: Stop every sound Lunchpad is playing.

setAudioDevice.doc: Make a device the system default output (speakers) or input (microphone).

fields.name: device
fields.doc: Device name as the system lists it (placeholders allowed)

addToVariable.doc: Add a number to a variable (counters); missing or non-numeric values count as 0.

fields.name: amount
fields.doc: Number or placeholder, negative to subtract

setSystemVolume.doc: Volume or mute of the default output or input device. `volume` is the level (0-100 %) for `Set`, the step for `Adjust`, unused for the mutes.

fields.name: volumeFrom
fields.doc: Variable or placeholder that overrides `volume` when it holds a number

fields.name: device
fields.doc: A specific device by name; `None` = the system's default device

slobsStudioMode.doc: Studio mode on/off, or push the preview live.

homeAssistantTurn.doc: Home Assistant: turn an entity on or off (or toggle it)

homeAssistantSetValue.doc: Home Assistant: set a numeric property, fixed or from a variable / fader

fields.name: valueFrom
fields.doc: Variable or placeholder that overrides `value` when it holds a number

homeAssistantCallService.doc: Home Assistant: call any service; `data` is JSON and may contain placeholders

httpRequest.doc: Any HTTP call. URL, headers, body and auth may contain `{{velocity}}`, `{{x}}`, `{{y}}` and `{{pageId}}`.

fields.name: contentType
fields.doc: Content-Type for the body (`None` sends none / lets the mode decide)

fields.name: body
fields.doc: Text body, or `name=value` lines for a multipart form

fields.name: bodyFile
fields.doc: File whose bytes are sent as the body (`body_mode = File`)

fields.name: files
fields.doc: File parts of a multipart form (`body_mode = Multipart`)

fields.name: saveTo
fields.doc: Store the response body in this variable (`<name>.status` gets the status code, `<name>.file` the saved file, `<name>.cached` whether the file was reused)

fields.name: response
fields.doc: What becomes of the response: text only, or a file in the download folder made from the body, a base64 field or a URL in a field

fields.name: responseField
fields.doc: JSON field (dot path, `data.0.url`) for the field modes; empty = the whole body

fields.name: fileName
fields.doc: File name (placeholders allowed) in the download folder, or an absolute path; empty = a name derived from the request

fields.name: reuse
fields.doc: Skip the request when a file (or stored text) for the same inputs exists

ifStart.doc: Branch: actions up to `IfElse` run when the condition holds, actions between `IfElse` and `IfEnd` when it does not.

setVariable.doc: Set a variable to a value (placeholders allowed).

runScript.doc: Run a JavaScript snippet with access to the variables; its result can be stored in a variable.

VarScope.doc: Where a variable lives: `Local` registers belong to one macro run (and the buttons it calls), `Global` variables are shared by every macro.

HttpResponse.doc: What an HTTP action does with the response body.

values.doc: Keep the text in the variable only
A field holds base64 data (a data URL prefix is fine)
A field holds a URL to download
multipart/form-data: `body` lines as text fields, `files` as file parts

fields.name: field
fields.doc: Form field name, e.g. "file"

fields.name: filename
fields.doc: Filename sent to the server; defaults to the file's own name

fields.name: contentType
fields.doc: Content type of the part; guessed from the extension when empty

ButtonRef.doc: Reference to a button; `page_id: None` means the page of the calling button.

ButtonTrigger.doc: Which list of another button to run.

VolumeUnit.doc: How a volume number is meant: decibels, or percent of the app's own scale.

values.doc: Change the level by the amount (negative = quieter)
Make the preview scene live (studio mode must be on)

WindowTarget.doc: Which window a window action means.

values.doc: The window with the focus right now
To `x`, `y`, on `screen` when given (a blank coordinate keeps the window's place)
On `screen`, or on the window's own screen
To `screen`, keeping the window's place on it

MouseStep.doc: One step of a mouse sequence. Coordinates and amounts are strings so they take placeholders.

variants.doc: Put the pointer at `x`, `y`, or with `relative` move it by that much
Click `clicks` times (1–5) where the pointer is
Hold a button down until a release step
Turn the wheel by `amount` notches: positive down (or right)
Press a button where the pointer is, move to `x`, `y`, let go

PadColor.doc: What a pad's LED shows. Palette indices refer to Novation's 128 colours.

MouseButton.doc: A mouse button as the actions name it.

HaPower.doc: On / off / toggle through the `homeassistant` domain, which works for every entity kind.

HaValueKind.doc: Numeric things an entity can be set to.

values.doc: `number` / `input_number` value, in the entity's own unit
